title: Emulator Core as a Reusable Library with UI Shells as Thin Consumers
body: The ViceSharp emulator core shall be packaged as a standalone .NET library (NuGet package) with no dependencies on any UI framework, windowing system, or platform-specific API. UI applications (desktop, web, headless test harness, embedded) consume the library and provide their own rendering, audio output, and input handling through well-defined abstractions.
